title: [PDF] Hippocampal sharp-wave ripples correlate with periods of naturally occurring self-generated thoughts in humans | Semantic Scholar
abstract:
Sharp-wave ripples (SWR) rates were higher during extended periods of time when participants’ ongoing thoughts were more vivid, less desirable, had more imaginable properties, and exhibited fewer correlations with an external task. Core features of human cognition highlight the importance of the capacity to focus on information distinct from events in the here and now, such as mind wandering.
